create_solver: create a Solver instance with euclidean projection and a random seed for reproducible initialization
init_solver_vars: initialize solver variables with a given number of strategies and players
compute_solver_gradients: compute gradients of exploitability with respect to strategy distribution parameters
run_mirror_descent_step: run an entropic mirror descent step to update strategy distribution using log-space softmax
run_euc_descent_step: run a projected gradient descent step with Euclidean simplex projection on strategy distribution
